separation_rules: A draft PR is not merged or production-ready, even when GitHub reports mergeable.
Q9 8 discovered leads and Q10 8 reviews are the SAME eight candidates; never add.
Closing an obsolete draft requires confirming its distinct artifacts and receipts remain available and linking to their successor. No automatic closing here.
Security pass, semantic grade, source license and behavioral validation are four separate concepts.
New issue or PR owner mapping is subject to re-reading current source heads; no inferred missing PR from search alone.
